KEY PRODUCT FEATURES

• 100-card ready-to-play Strixhaven STX Commander deck (2 foil, 98 nonfoil cards)
• 1 foil etched Display Commander
• 10 double-sided tokens + life tracker and deck box
• 17 Magic cards make their debut
• Reduced-plastic packaging
• Choose your college at the most prestigious university for magical learning in MTG's Multiverse
• Join Quandrix College and find power in numbers with a multiplying army of tokens

CONTENTS

Welcome to Strixhaven, the most prestigious university for magical learning in Magic’s Multiverse. Join your fellow students in the college of Quandrix and battle it out with this Blue-Green Strixhaven Commander deck.

The Quandrix Strixhaven: School of Mages Commander Deck set includes 1 ready-to-play deck of 100 Magic cards (2 foil, 98 nonfoil), 1 foil etched Display Commander, 10 double-sided tokens, 1 life tracker, 1 deck box (can hold 100 sleeved cards), and 1 reference card, all in reduced-plastic packaging.
